prompts.a:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original seamless game-material authoring source, live oak bark.
Create a square 2048x2048 orthographic, edge-to-edge texture painting of mature LIVE OAK bark, an unwrapped flat patch measuring 1.6 metres across by 2 metres vertically. No trunk silhouette, scene, perspective, text or border. The vertical direction is along the trunk.
Chunky, strongly three-dimensional long blocky bark plates, irregular roughly rectangular interlocking fragments, lifted and split in layers, NOT smooth bark and NOT thin wormlike black squiggles. About 16 to 22 irregular plates across the width and 12 to 17 along the height, variable size (4–15 cm wide, 6–25 cm long). Dark narrow fissures branch and rejoin primarily vertically; offset cross breaks interrupt ridges. No aligned horizontal courses, no hexagonal cells, no brick grid. Some tapering fragments and short overlapping flakes lie on broad plate faces. All grain meanders together gently up the image, with no knot, scar, radial swirl or distinctive landmark.
Richly tactile dry dense hardwood, warm mid-brown broad plate faces #6D5A43, some #5A4A38 and #7A6550; weathered edges and old faces muted warm grey #81725A; deep fissures very dark brown #2E2A24, deepest almost black brown. Small scattered grey-green lichen pinpricks, very sparse, no large lichen patches. Sharp dry fractured edges, porous fine surface detail, small chipped terraces.
Flat neutral diffuse illumination across the entire image, albedo-like material colours: no directional sun, no cast shadows, no side-to-side lighting gradient, no glossy highlights. Deep cavities remain materially dark. Colour and shape density evenly distributed with subtle natural variation. Make opposite edges seamlessly repeat in both directions. High-fidelity original material, no references from any existing game. This is bark of an old spreading subtropical oak, not pine, redwood, cork, rock or reptile skin.
